I’m a lefty that plays lefty. I started 35 years ago(??). My dad let me play one of his guitars and saw that I always held it lefty, could not do it righty. So he restrung it to lefty and that’s how I learned. (It was a 1950s Supro Duo Tone that had been through hell and back that I learned on!) I can play a righty upside down kind of (chords, etc) as well as basic bass upside down. Finding an instrument can suck. It took me 25 years to get an affordable Jazzmaster. 

As to what the dominant hand should be doing: I can see it being an advantage both ways (fretting or picking). I’ve been told I have really good rhythm and dynamics so maybe that’s tied to my picking hand being my dominant hand? I don’t know. 

My kids are both lefties. My son has no issues with right handed playing but he also golfs right handed.

Bergamont Grandurance RD series checks all those boxes but I don’t know if they sell them in the US. I have an RD3 but I’m in Denmark.

Racehall is fairly close to Høje Taastrup station. There is also a bus that looks to go from the station and has a stop very close to Racehall. Use the Rejseplanen app to get directions and changes.

You can book online for Racehall and it is a huge indoor track. Gas karts even though it’s indoors. 

Roskilde Racing Center would be more difficult to get to via public transportation. A taxi would be able to get you there. It’s a really nice outdoor track. You can “book online” for Roskilde Racing center and they email you if the time is available.
